name: Healing Power
overview: Scripture reveals that healing is a divine attribute rooted in God's character and redemptive work. God promises health and protection to those who obey His commands, declaring Himself as the one who heals (Exodus 15:26). The healing power of Christ is emphasized in His sacrificial suffering, through which believers are healed spiritually and physically (Isaiah 53:5), and in His authority given to the disciples to heal sickness and cast out unclean spirits (Matthew 10:1). Faith-filled prayer is integral to receiving healing, as Jesus teaches that believers should pray with confidence, trusting they will receive what they ask for (Mark 11:24), while He came to give abundant life, encompassing wholeness and restoration (John 10:10).
